scripts.dev: node scripts/write-info-plist.mjs src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.install:web: npm ci --prefix ../frontend && npm ci --prefix ../viewer && npm ci --prefix ../board
